all.description: Every lesson available to you: public lessons and the ones you take part in as a teacher or a student. Use the search and filters to narrow the calendar down.

study.description: Lessons of your student group: lectures, practical classes and other events scheduled for it, including the ones visible only to their participants.
study.noProfile: You don't have a student profile. Ask an administrator to add one.
study.noGroup: You are not in a student group yet. Ask an administrator to add you to one.

description.teaching: Lessons you teach, on your own or together with other teachers. Click a free slot in the calendar or use “Add lesson” to schedule a new one.
description.department: All lessons linked to the department you head. As the head, you can edit any of them, even the ones you don't teach.

teaching.noProfile: You don't have a teacher profile. Ask an administrator to add one.

admin.noAccess: You don't have access to lessons management. Ask an administrator to grant you the permissions you need.
admin.descriptionManage: Every lesson of the platform, public or not, whoever teaches it. You can edit any lesson and manage lesson groups: rename them, move lessons between them or delete them.
admin.descriptionView: Every lesson of the platform, public or not, whoever teaches it. View only: editing needs the “Manage all lessons” permission.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Show only the lessons that match every selected filter. Within one filter, a lesson fits if it matches any of the chosen values.

form.createDescription: Schedule a lesson for one or several student groups. You stay among its teachers, and later it can be edited by every teacher of the lesson and by the heads of its departments. Add it to a lesson group to create a whole series at once.
form.editDescription: Changes apply to this lesson only. To move it, change the date and time it starts at.
form.editDescriptionInGroup: Part of “{{group}}”. Changes apply to this lesson only, not to the other lessons of the group. To move it, change the date and time it starts at.
form.name: Name
form.notePlaceholder: What to bring, where to meet…

recurrence.title: Lesson group
recurrence.description: Lessons that belong together, such as a course or a cycle of lectures. Every lesson of the series gets the fields above, and the first one takes place at “Starts at”.
recurrence.noOwnGroups: You have no lesson groups yet

patterns.biweekly: Every two weeks, on chosen days

recurrence.tooMany: More than {{count}} lessons: shorten the range

hints.none: Only this lesson goes into the group; you can add more lessons to it later.
hints.range: Days follow the rule above. Switch to Custom dates to pick them by hand.
hints.custom: Click days to add or remove lessons. The first one is fixed at “Starts at”.

groups.emptySearch: No lesson groups match the search

overview.editDescription: Rename the group or update its note. Its lessons are edited on a separate screen.
overview.name: Name

lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.hint: Pick lessons to take them out of the group or delete them together.
lessons.empty: No lessons in this group yet
lessons.confirmDeleteOne: Delete “{{name}}” ({{date}})? It is removed from the schedule for everyone. This can't be undone.
lessons.confirmDeleteMany_one: Delete {{count}} lesson? It is removed from the schedule for everyone. This can't be undone.
lessons.confirmDeleteMany_other: Delete {{count}} lessons? They are removed from the schedule for everyone. This can't be undone.
lessons.confirmTakeOutOne: Take “{{name}}” ({{date}}) out of the group? It stays in the schedule, without a group.
lessons.confirmTakeOutMany_one: Take {{count}} lesson out of the group? It stays in the schedule, without a group.
lessons.confirmTakeOutMany_other: Take {{count}} lessons out of the group? They stay in the schedule, without a group.
lessons.takenOut: Lessons taken out of the group

assign.title: Add lessons to the group
assign.description: Pick existing lessons to put into “{{name}}”. The selection is kept across pages and searches. A lesson belongs to one group only, so a lesson of another group moves here.

deleteModal.withLessons_one: Its {{count}} lesson will be deleted too. This can't be undone.
deleteModal.withLessons_other: Its {{count}} lessons will be deleted too. This can't be undone.
deleteModal.keepLessons_one: Its {{count}} lesson stays in the schedule, without a group.
deleteModal.keepLessons_other: Its {{count}} lessons stay in the schedule, without a group.
